records.title: Widening of Nh-11 Road from Jhunjhunu to Fatehpur
details:
(a) to (c) The process for preparation of Detailed Project Report
(DPR) for development of NH-11 from Jhunjhunu to Fatehpur to four-
lanes has been initiated in January, 2026. Based on the outcome of
the DPR, this stretch would be considered for upgradation to four-
lanes subject to traffic requirements and synergy with PM Gati
Shakti National Master Plan (NMP).

records.title: Widening of Nh-11 Road from Jhunjhunu to Fatehpur
details: डीपीआर के बाद ये सब चीजें विजुएलाइज़ करने के बाद ही फोर लेन की तरफ जाएंगे। ऐसी उम्मीद की जा रही है कि डीपीआर का काम दिसंबर, 2026 तक समाप्त हो जाएगा।

records.title: STATUS OF NH-11A
details:
The Government has
taken up preparation of Detailed Project Report (DPR) for
development of Pacheri-Jhunjhunu section of NH-11, which is
presently at feasibility study stage.
